_meta.title: Ruler-sign clauses for empty-house composer (saved, reviewed)
_meta.model: planet = function/verb; sign = how it operates
_meta.rulers: 7 traditional only (outer planets are co-rulers, expanded mode)
_meta.note: Built once and saved; the composer looks these up, never re-authoring at runtime. 'generational' holds the outer co-rulers' collective sign stories for expanded mode.

clauses.sun|aries: With the Sun in Aries, your identity comes through bold and direct: you'd rather start something than wait to be asked.
clauses.sun|taurus: With the Sun in Taurus, you know who you are slowly and solidly, and you don't move until it feels worth it.
clauses.sun|gemini: With the Sun in Gemini, your sense of self runs on curiosity and talk; you try on ideas the way others try on clothes.
clauses.sun|cancer: With the Sun in Cancer, you're most yourself when you're caring for something, and you lead with feeling.
clauses.sun|leo: With the Sun in Leo, you come alive when you're seen; your identity wants warmth, play, and something to create.
clauses.sun|virgo: With the Sun in Virgo, you know yourself through what you refine and improve; being useful is how you shine.
clauses.sun|libra: With the Sun in Libra, your identity forms in relationship; you find yourself in the space between you and another.
clauses.sun|scorpio: With the Sun in Scorpio, you're most yourself in the deep end, where things are real, private, and intense.
clauses.sun|sagittarius: With the Sun in Sagittarius, your sense of self needs room to roam: a bigger view, a truth to chase, a horizon.
clauses.sun|capricorn: With the Sun in Capricorn, you know who you are by what you build and take responsibility for.
clauses.sun|aquarius: With the Sun in Aquarius, your identity is a little outside the norm; you want to build things that shift the status quo.
clauses.sun|pisces: With the Sun in Pisces, you're most yourself at the edges, where feeling, imagination, and compassion blur the lines.
clauses.moon|aries: With the Moon in Aries, you feel things fast and hot, and you need to act on a mood before it cools.
clauses.moon|taurus: With the Moon in Taurus, you settle when life is calm and physical; comfort, food, and steadiness soothe you.
clauses.moon|gemini: With the Moon in Gemini, you process feelings by talking them out, and your mood shifts with the conversation.
clauses.moon|cancer: With the Moon in Cancer, your feelings run the show, and safety comes from home and the people who feel like yours.
clauses.moon|leo: With the Moon in Leo, you want love to feel wholehearted, loyal, and recognized.
clauses.moon|virgo: With the Moon in Virgo, you feel safest when things are handled; a tidy detail can settle your whole mood.
clauses.moon|libra: With the Moon in Libra, you feel steady when things are fair and harmonious, and conflict unsettles you fast.
clauses.moon|scorpio: With the Moon in Scorpio, your feelings run deep and private, and you don't do shallow reassurance.
clauses.moon|sagittarius: With the Moon in Sagittarius, you feel best with room to breathe and something to look forward to.
clauses.moon|capricorn: With the Moon in Capricorn, you steady yourself with structure, and you'd rather handle a feeling than sit in it.
clauses.moon|aquarius: With the Moon in Aquarius, you need space to feel from a little distance; you process feelings by understanding them.
clauses.moon|pisces: With the Moon in Pisces, you soak up the emotional weather around you and feel everything at the edges.
clauses.mercury|aries: With Mercury in Aries, you think fast and say it faster; your mind moves in quick, direct bursts.
clauses.mercury|taurus: With Mercury in Taurus, you think slowly and thoroughly, and once you've decided, you don't budge easily.
clauses.mercury|gemini: With Mercury in Gemini, your mind is quick, curious, and everywhere at once; you learn by talking and linking ideas.
clauses.mercury|cancer: With Mercury in Cancer, you think with your feelings, and memory and mood color how you take things in.
clauses.mercury|leo: With Mercury in Leo, you think in big, confident strokes, and you speak to be heard and to inspire.
clauses.mercury|virgo: With Mercury in Virgo, your mind is precise and analytical; you notice the error everyone else missed.
clauses.mercury|libra: With Mercury in Libra, you think in comparisons and both-sides, weighing every option before you commit.
clauses.mercury|scorpio: With Mercury in Scorpio, your mind digs; you're not satisfied until you've found what's really going on.
clauses.mercury|sagittarius: With Mercury in Sagittarius, you think in big pictures and possibilities, sometimes past the inconvenient details.
clauses.mercury|capricorn: With Mercury in Capricorn, your thinking is structured and practical; you want the plan, not the brainstorm.
clauses.mercury|aquarius: With Mercury in Aquarius, your mind runs on the unexpected angle; you think in systems and against the grain.
clauses.mercury|pisces: With Mercury in Pisces, you think in images and intuition, and facts blur into what feels true.
clauses.venus|aries: With Venus in Aries, you love fast and direct, and you'd rather chase than be kept guessing.
clauses.venus|taurus: With Venus in Taurus, you love steadily and sensually; loyalty, touch, and the good things say it best.
clauses.venus|gemini: With Venus in Gemini, you love through words and wit, and a good conversation is your love language.
clauses.venus|cancer: With Venus in Cancer, you love by caring and being cared for; closeness means feeling safe with someone.
clauses.venus|leo: With Venus in Leo, you love generously and out loud; you want romance with a little grandeur.
clauses.venus|virgo: With Venus in Virgo, you love through the practical: showing up, fixing, remembering the small things.
clauses.venus|libra: With Venus in Libra, you love beauty, balance, and partnership itself; harmony is the point.
clauses.venus|scorpio: With Venus in Scorpio, you love all the way in: intense, loyal, and allergic to anything halfway.
clauses.venus|sagittarius: With Venus in Sagittarius, you love freedom and adventure in a partner; keep it honest and keep it moving.
clauses.venus|capricorn: With Venus in Capricorn, you love with commitment and staying power; you invest where it can last.
clauses.venus|aquarius: With Venus in Aquarius, you love as a friend first, and you need freedom inside the closeness.
clauses.venus|pisces: With Venus in Pisces, you love romantically and boundlessly, seeing the best in whoever you fall for.
clauses.mars|aries: With Mars in Aries, you go after what you want head-on, and sitting still is the hardest thing you do.
clauses.mars|taurus: With Mars in Taurus, you move slowly but you don't stop; your drive is stubborn and built to last.
clauses.mars|gemini: With Mars in Gemini, your energy goes into words and quick moves; you fight and flirt with your wit.
clauses.mars|cancer: With Mars in Cancer, you act to protect what's yours, and your drive runs on feeling, not logic.
clauses.mars|leo: With Mars in Leo, you act with flair and pride; you want your effort seen and your courage recognized.
clauses.mars|virgo: With Mars in Virgo, your energy goes into doing it right; you work hard and sweat the details.
clauses.mars|libra: With Mars in Libra, you act through others and hate a fight, so you push by persuading, not shoving.
clauses.mars|scorpio: With Mars in Scorpio, your drive is intense and strategic; you go quiet, then you go all the way.
clauses.mars|sagittarius: With Mars in Sagittarius, you chase the big goal with enthusiasm, sometimes overshooting the practical part.
clauses.mars|capricorn: With Mars in Capricorn, you work with discipline toward a real result; your ambition is patient and relentless.
clauses.mars|aquarius: With Mars in Aquarius, you act on principle and your own timing, and you resist being told how to move.
clauses.mars|pisces: With Mars in Pisces, your drive ebbs and flows with your mood; you move best toward something you believe in.
clauses.jupiter|aries: With Jupiter in Aries, you grow by going first and betting on yourself; boldness tends to pay off for you.
clauses.jupiter|taurus: With Jupiter in Taurus, you grow through patience and building; abundance comes to you slowly and stays.
clauses.jupiter|gemini: With Jupiter in Gemini, you grow through learning and connecting; your luck runs through ideas and people.
clauses.jupiter|cancer: With Jupiter in Cancer, you grow through care and roots; your good fortune lives in home and belonging.
clauses.jupiter|leo: With Jupiter in Leo, you grow by expressing yourself fully; confidence and creativity open your doors.
clauses.jupiter|virgo: With Jupiter in Virgo, you grow through craft and usefulness; small, careful improvements compound for you.
clauses.jupiter|libra: With Jupiter in Libra, you grow through relationship and fairness; partnership expands your world.
clauses.jupiter|scorpio: With Jupiter in Scorpio, you grow through depth and transformation; you gain by letting the shallow things go.
clauses.jupiter|sagittarius: With Jupiter in Sagittarius, you grow by reaching for meaning and horizon; faith and adventure are your fuel.
clauses.jupiter|capricorn: With Jupiter in Capricorn, you grow through discipline and structure; you earn your expansion the real way.
clauses.jupiter|aquarius: With Jupiter in Aquarius, you grow through vision and community; your luck runs through the unconventional.
clauses.jupiter|pisces: With Jupiter in Pisces, you grow through faith, art, and compassion; you gain by trusting the current.
clauses.saturn|aries: With Saturn in Aries, you build discipline around action: learning to start wisely, not just fast.
clauses.saturn|taurus: With Saturn in Taurus, your structure is around worth and security; you learn what's truly enough.
clauses.saturn|gemini: With Saturn in Gemini, you build discipline around your mind and voice: say less, mean more.
clauses.saturn|cancer: With Saturn in Cancer, your work is around emotional security: building a foundation you didn't inherit.
clauses.saturn|leo: With Saturn in Leo, you learn to earn recognition rather than demand it; real confidence takes time.
clauses.saturn|virgo: With Saturn in Virgo, your discipline is around service and standards: useful, not perfect.
clauses.saturn|libra: With Saturn in Libra, you build structure around commitment and fairness; you learn what you owe and are owed.
clauses.saturn|scorpio: With Saturn in Scorpio, your work is around trust and control: learning what's safe to depend on.
clauses.saturn|sagittarius: With Saturn in Sagittarius, you build discipline around belief: testing your faith instead of borrowing it.
clauses.saturn|capricorn: With Saturn in Capricorn, your structure is around authority and time; you become your own hard-won authority.
clauses.saturn|aquarius: With Saturn in Aquarius, you build discipline around vision: turning ideals into things that actually hold.
clauses.saturn|pisces: With Saturn in Pisces, your work is around faith and boundaries: giving form to the formless.

generational.uranus|aries: Your generation disrupts how people assert and begin; independence runs in your wiring
generational.uranus|taurus: Your generation upends money, value, and the body; you rethink what security even means
generational.uranus|gemini: Your generation reinvents how people think and talk; the channels of communication mutate
generational.uranus|cancer: Your generation redefines home and family; the old shape of belonging breaks open
generational.uranus|leo: Your generation reinvents self-expression and what it means to be seen
generational.uranus|virgo: Your generation overhauls work, health, and systems; you disrupt the daily machine
generational.uranus|libra: Your generation reinvents relationship and fairness; old contracts get rewritten
generational.uranus|scorpio: Your generation cracks open taboo, power, and shared resources
generational.uranus|sagittarius: Your generation disrupts belief and truth; the old certainties get exploded
generational.uranus|capricorn: Your generation dismantles and rebuilds institutions; the structures themselves change
generational.uranus|aquarius: Your generation is the disruptor archetype itself; you reinvent the collective
generational.uranus|pisces: Your generation dissolves and reimagines faith and imagination
generational.neptune|aries: Your generation dreams of the heroic and the new self; ideals wear armor
generational.neptune|taurus: Your generation romanticizes the earth, money, and the body; you dream of real abundance
generational.neptune|gemini: Your generation idealizes information and connection; truth and story blur
generational.neptune|cancer: Your generation dreams of home and belonging, and grieves what never was
generational.neptune|leo: Your generation romanticizes self-expression and glamour; the dream is to be luminous
generational.neptune|virgo: Your generation dreams of the perfect system and pure service; ideals meet the details
generational.neptune|libra: Your generation romanticizes love and fairness; the dream is perfect union
generational.neptune|scorpio: Your generation dreams into the depths, power, and the unseen; intensity and illusion mix
generational.neptune|sagittarius: Your generation romanticizes belief and the far horizon; faith can inspire or delude
generational.neptune|capricorn: Your generation dreams of ideal structures and dissolves brittle ones
generational.neptune|aquarius: Your generation dreams of utopia and universal connection
generational.neptune|pisces: Your generation is the dreamer archetype itself; the veil is thinnest here
generational.pluto|aries: Your generation transforms through raw will and the birth of the new self
generational.pluto|taurus: Your generation transforms money, value, and the body from the roots
generational.pluto|gemini: Your generation transforms thought and communication at the deepest level
generational.pluto|cancer: Your generation transforms home, family, and belonging through upheaval
generational.pluto|leo: Your generation transforms self-expression and the ego's power
generational.pluto|virgo: Your generation transforms work, health, and the systems of daily life
generational.pluto|libra: Your generation transforms relationship, justice, and the terms of fairness
generational.pluto|scorpio: Your generation is the transformer archetype itself; you regenerate through the depths
generational.pluto|sagittarius: Your generation transforms belief, truth, and the reach of the mind
generational.pluto|capricorn: Your generation transforms institutions and authority from the foundation
generational.pluto|aquarius: Your generation transforms the collective, technology, and who holds power
generational.pluto|pisces: Your generation transforms faith, imagination, and the dissolving of old worlds
